title: God of war
description: God of War (2018) is an action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio that shifts the franchise [from Greek mythology to the Norse realm] of Midgard.

title: God of war: Ragnarok
description: God of War: Ragnarok Set as the direct sequel to the 2018 God of War, the game follows the duo as they journey through the Nine Realms to find answers before the prophesied end-of-days battle.

title: The Last of Us: part 1
description: The Last of Us Part I is a third-person action-adventure and survival game where you guide a hardened smuggler and an immune teenager through a ruined America.

title: The Last of Us: part 2
description: The Last of Us Part II is an action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic United States five years after the events of the original game.

title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
description: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End is a 2016 action-adventure game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.

title: Beyond: Two Souls
description: Beyond: Two Souls is a psychological action-thriller and interactive drama game that follows the remarkable life of Jodie Holmes.

title: Detroit: Become Human
description: Detroit: Become Human is a cinematic interactive drama and action-adventure game developed by Quantic Dream.

title: Max Payne 3
description: Max Payne 3 is a dark, cinematic third-person shooter developed by Rockstar Games.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Grand Theft Auto V is a 2013 action-adventure, open-world game developed by Rockstar North and published by Rockstar Games.

title: Mad Max
description: Mad Max is an open-world, third-person action-adventure video game that features heavy vehicular combat and brutal hand-to-hand melee fighting.

title: Heavy Rain
description: Heavy Rain is an interactive drama and psychological thriller video game developed by Quantic Dream.

title: Resident Evil 4: Remake
description: Resident Evil 4 is a survival horror and third-person shooter video game developed and published by CAPCOM, released on March 24, 2023, as a complete remake of the 2005 classic Resident Evil 4.

title: 007 First Light
description: 007 First Light is an action-adventure video game developed by IO Interactive that tells the origin story of James Bond before he earned his 00 status.

title: Battlefield V
description: Battlefield V is a first-person shooter video game set in World War II, developed by DICE and published by Electronic Arts.

title: Battlefield 1
description: Battlefield 1 is a first-person shooter video game set during World War I, developed by DICE and published by Electronic Arts in 2016.

title: Cuphead
description: Cuphead is a classic run-and-gun action video game developed by Studio MDHR that is heavily inspired by 1930s-style rubber hose animated cartoons.

title: Sleeping Dogs
description: Sleeping Dogs is an open-world action-adventure video game set in a gritty version of Hong Kong.

title: Doom Eternal
description: Doom Eternal is an epic first-person shooter game where you play as the Doom Slayer to stop Hell's armies from destroying Earth and humanity.

title: The Evil Within
description: The Evil Within is a survival horror video game created by Shinji Mikami, the father of the Resident Evil series.

title: The Evil Within 2
description: The Evil Within 2 is a survival horror game developed by Tango Gameworks and published by Bethesda Softworks in October 2017.

title: Fight Night Champion
description: Fight Night Champion is a realistic boxing video game released in 2011 by Electronic Arts.

title: God of War III
description: God of War III is a single-player action-adventure game set in the realm of brutal Greek mythology.

title: Hitman: Absolution
description: Hitman: Absolution is a stealth-action video game released on November 20, 2012, by IO Interactive.

title: For Honor
description: For Honor is an online third-person hack-and-slash action and tactical fighting game developed and published by Ubisoft.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2
description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance is a realistic, story-driven open-world action RPG set in 15th-century medieval Bohemia.

title: Little Nightmares
description: Little Nightmares is a dark, whimsical puzzle-platformer and psychological horror game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment.

title: Little Nightmares II
description: Little Nightmares II is a suspense-adventure puzzle-platformer horror game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment.

title: Little Nightmares III
description: Little Nightmares III is an atmospheric puzzle-adventure and horror video game developed by Supermassive Games and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment.

title: Mafia III
description: Mafia III is an open-world, third-person action-adventure video game developed by Hangar 13 and published by 2K Games.

title: Medal of Honor: Warfighter
description: Medal of Honor: Warfighter is a first-person shooter video game released in 2012 by Electronic Arts and developed by Danger Close Games.

title: Mortal Kombat 1
description: Mortal Kombat 1 is a 2023 fighting video game developed by NetherRealm Studios and published by Warner Bros. Games.

title: MotorStorm: Apocalypse
description: MotorStorm: Apocalypse is a 2011 off-road arcade racing video game developed by Evolution Studios and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 3.

title: The Order: 1886
description: The Order: 1886 is a 2015 action-adventure video game set in an alternate history of Neo-Victorian London.

title: A Way Out
description: A Way Out is a 2018 cooperative action-adventure video game developed by Hazelight Studios and published by Electronic Arts.

title: Resident Evil 2: Remake
description: Resident Evil 2 (2019) is a survival horror video game developed and published by Capcom as a complete ground-up reimagining of the classic 1998 original.

title: Resident Evil Requiem
description: Resident Evil Requiem (informally known as Resident Evil 9) is a survival horror video game developed and published by CAPCOM Co., Ltd. released on February 26, 2026.

title: Ryse: Son of Rome
description: Ryse: Son of Rome is a 2013 action-adventure video game developed by Crytek that follows the personal journey of Roman soldier Marius Titus as he seeks vengeance for his murdered family.

title: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice
description: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice is a dark fantasy action-adventure game that follows Senua, a traumatized Celtic warrior journeying through a Viking underworld to save her dead lover's soul.

title: Street Fighter 6
description: Street Fighter 6 is a 2023 fighting game developed and published by Capcom that represents the next evolution of the iconic Street Fighter series.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Blacklist
description: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Blacklist is an action-adventure stealth game developed by Ubisoft Toronto and published by Ubisoft in 2013.

title: Unravel Two
description: Unravel Two is a 2018 puzzle-platformer video game developed by Coldwood Interactive and published by Electronic Arts.

title: Until Dawn
description: Until Dawn is a survival horror interactive drama video game developed by Supermassive Games.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
description: Assassin's Creed Valhalla is an action role-playing video game released in 2020. You play as Eivor, a Viking raider who leads a clan from Norway to the rich lands of 9th-century England.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world action role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red.

title: Wolfenstein: The New Order
description: Wolfenstein: The New Order is an action-adventure first-person shooter developed by MachineGames and published by Bethesda Softworks.

title: Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus
description: Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus is a 2017 first-person shooter game developed by MachineGames and published by Bethesda Softworks.

title: Marvel's Wolverine
description: Marvel's Wolverine for the PlayStation 5 is a linear action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games that delivers a mature, ferocious, and cinematic take on the iconic X-Men hero Logan.

title: Wreckfest
description: Wreckfest is a demolition derby-themed racing video game developed by Bugbear Entertainment and published by THQ Nordic.

title: Killzone Shadow Fall
description: Killzone Shadow Fall is a 2013 futuristic first-person shooter video game developed by Guerrilla Games and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 4

title: Batman: Arkham Knight
description: Batman: Arkham Knight is an action-adventure video game that concludes the acclaimed Arkham trilogy by Rocksteady Studios.
